stories.title: Nike launches its first running shoe designed for India
stories.summary: Nike is launching Vegam Run, its first running shoe designed for India, on November 1, priced at Rs 3,795, afaqs reports. Nike says it used insights from runners across India and is positioning the shoe as an entry point into running and everyday movement.

stories.title: Deconstruct lets oily skin judge the serums
stories.summary: Deconstruct picked 10 participants from more than 6,000 registrations across South India for a day of tests in Chennai, applying two unidentified serums to opposite sides of their faces, afaqs reports. The first test checked stickiness by placing feathers on the skin.

stories.title: Liebherr makes peace with how India says its name
stories.summary: Liebherr Appliances India's new film, Mispronounced by Everyone. Loved by All, follows households saying the name as Lyber or Lieber before revealing the correct LeeBh-err, while showing off refrigerator features, afaqs reports. The brand has chosen acceptance over correction, mostly.

stories.title: Licious spins off its snacks as Sizzl
stories.summary: Licious has rebranded its ready to eat range of momos, kebabs, tikkas and protein meals as Sizzl, a sub-brand aimed at younger consumers, afaqs reports. It was unveiled in Mumbai at a creator led event attended by more than 300 celebrities and content creators.

stories.title: Mars brings Celebrations gift packs to India
stories.summary: Mars has launched Celebrations in India, mixing miniature Snickers, Galaxy, Bounty and Twix, afaqs reports. First launched globally in 1997, it arrives around Diwali in a Rs 270 box of 12 treats and a Rs 500 box of 20.

stories.title: How PepsiCo priced Sting into a mass energy drink
stories.summary: When PepsiCo launched Sting in India in 2017, energy drinks were a niche led by premium brands such as Red Bull. Sting entered at Rs 20 for 200 ml, an afaqs case study notes, and stepped up advertising in 2021 with Akshay Kumar.

stories.title: Spotify sets Diwali chores to music with the Gullak cast
stories.summary: Spotify's Diwali campaign follows TVF's Gullak family, the Mishras, across three films as they make laddoos, draw rangoli and untangle lights to songs including Chaiya Chaiya, afaqs reports. The family bickers through each task. Untangling the lights remains undefeated.

stories.title: Hyundai turns a newspaper ad into an audio experience
stories.summary: Hyundai ran a four page print innovation in Hindustan Times across Delhi and Mumbai for the Bayon that connects the physical newspaper with audio, Manifest Media reports. Havas Media India worked on it with Innocean under the proposition Intelligence That Moves.

stories.title: Brands crowd the New York City Marathon's 50th anniversary
stories.summary: This year's New York City Marathon marks 50 years of the five borough race and is expected to break participant records, Digiday reports. Beyond Nike, New Balance and Hoka, Maybelline is the race's first ever beauty sponsor, and restaurants are courting carb loading runners.

stories.title: i-choose pitches the ovulation kit as the pre-pregnancy test
stories.summary: Ovulation testing kit brand i-choose has launched The Pre-pregnancy Test, starring Shriya Pilgaonkar and conceptualised by McCann India, encouraging couples trying to conceive to move beyond guesswork, Passionate in Marketing reports. Most couples know the test after trying, the brand notes.

stories.title: DOMS lets the child pick her own future in its festive film
stories.summary: In a DOMS Industries festive film, relatives at a family gathering hand young Tara gifts representing futures they imagine for her, from business to architecture. Her brother gives her one that leaves the choice to her, afaqs reports. She wants to travel.

stories.title: Kärcher India casts old cleaning gear as Halloween villains
stories.summary: Kärcher India's Halloween campaign, When Outdated Tech Comes Back to Haunt, turns outdated cleaning equipment into the villains of a playful story about technology and progress, Passionate in Marketing reports. The monster under the bed is apparently a mop.

stories.title: Lenovo stages a Broadway style film for its tablet
stories.summary: Lenovo's campaign for the Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 stars actor Abhay Varma in a film inspired by Broadway musicals, Indian Retailer reports. Developed by Kinnect, it builds on the Damn the Odds platform and targets people juggling work, studies and personal interests.

stories.title: Stagwell posts its best quarter as it lands a $1.5 billion federal deal
stories.summary: Stagwell reported Q3 net revenue of $664 million, up 8 per cent, and EBITDA of $145 million, up 25 per cent, Adweek reports. It also has a new five year, $1.5 billion deal with a federal government department. Its stock rose 9.85 per cent after the report.

stories.title: Dentsu leaves its Worli headquarters for Andheri
stories.summary: Dentsu is moving out of Devchand House in Mumbai's Worli to Smartworks' The Square in Andheri East, afaqs reports. Announcing it on Instagram, the agency wrote: 'Worli to Andheri. New pin on the map. Same old chaos.' It says the move takes it closer to the airport.

stories.title: Zee raises ad spends 55 per cent as Q2 revenue grows 13 per cent
stories.summary: Zee Entertainment's operating revenue rose 13 per cent to Rs 2,224.6 crore, afaqs reports. Zee5 had its highest ever quarterly revenue, up 101 per cent to Rs 626 crore, after releasing 34 shows and movies, and subscription revenue grew 30 per cent.

stories.title: Network18 grows revenue 9.4 per cent in a weak ad market
stories.summary: Network18's Q2 FY27 operating revenue rose 9.4 per cent to Rs 545 crore, its fifth straight quarter of growth, afaqs reports. Ad inventory consumption in news fell about 13 per cent amid the West Asia conflict, a weak monsoon and suspended television ratings.

stories.title: Godrej Consumer lifts ad spends 2.2 per cent to Rs 327 crore
stories.summary: Godrej Consumer Products spent Rs 327.05 crore on advertising and publicity in Q2 FY27, up 2.2 per cent, while consolidated revenue grew 19 per cent to Rs 4,413.09 crore, afaqs reports. Ad spend was about 7.4 per cent of revenue.

stories.title: AAAI forms a council for independent agencies
stories.summary: The Advertising Agencies Association of India has formed an INDIE Council for independent agencies, headed by Tanya Goyal of Everest Advertising, afaqs reports. Its charter includes support for talent outside major metros and mentorship of emerging indie creators by seasoned practitioners.

stories.title: Cannes Lions takes award winning work out of the Palais in 2027
stories.summary: Cannes Lions will show award winning work beyond the Palais and into the city of Cannes for the first time in its 74 year history, Net Influencer reports. The 2027 overhaul also adds a festival wide passport and a Global Creative Assembly honouring the Creator Economy.

stories.title: WPP's Cindy Rose criticises deals done on a CEO handshake
stories.summary: WPP chief executive Cindy Rose criticised pitch-less CEO handshake deals, PRWeek reports, after PepsiCo moved its media account from Omnicom to Publicis in September. The full piece is for subscribers and registered readers.

stories.title: Forrester says data decided the cola media reviews
stories.summary: Forrester argues WPP and Omnicom's recent wins of Coca-Cola's global and North American media assignments come down to data, and that the Coca-Cola and PepsiCo reviews show two competing data strategies reshaping the global media agency market.

stories.title: Agencies adopted AI agents but kept the old org chart
stories.summary: Agencies have been enthusiastic adopters of AI agents, but team structures, job descriptions and career paths have been largely left untouched even as media buyers' daily work has changed, Digiday reports, arguing there is a window to reimagine staffing.

stories.title: Ykone expands into Tokyo and Milan through deals
stories.summary: Influencer marketing agency Ykone has taken a minority investment in Lateam, a Tokyo creative and social media agency founded by Pablo Yano, who stays on as chief executive of the firm, to be renamed Ykone Tokyo, WWD reports. Financial details were not disclosed.

stories.title: Grindr hires SAMY for influencer marketing
stories.summary: Dating app Grindr has appointed SAMY US as its agency of record for US and global influencer marketing after a competitive pitch, and SAMY as its social media agency across Latin America, LBB reports. The work focuses on brand reputation within GBTQ+ communities.

stories.title: Burger King India names its CFO as CEO
stories.summary: Restaurant Brands Asia has named Sumit Zaveri chief executive of its Burger King India business, announced with its Q2 FY27 results, afaqs reports. Zaveri was CFO of Burger King India and previously CFO for Nature's Basket and Tata Starbucks.

stories.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank hires Richa Dholi for credit card marketing
stories.summary: Richa Dholi has joined Kotak Mahindra Bank as head of marketing for credit cards, afaqs reports. She was global marketing director at Qure.ai and earlier led social media and new age content at HDFC Bank, working on Vigil Aunty and PayZapp.

stories.title: Motorola used 800 creators instead of banners for Big Billion Days
stories.summary: Motorola India worked with more than 800 creators through Idiotic Media for its 10 day Flipkart Big Billion Days campaign, reporting over 406 million views, more than one million clicks to its Flipkart pages and over 250,000 new social followers, Storyboard18 reports.

stories.title: Tubi pays TikTok creators to make long form shows
stories.summary: Fox owned free streamer Tubi will fund 10 original long form series from 12 TikTok creators, Kenter Tech Hub reports. In Luminate's October report, 57 per cent of US 18 to 24 year olds said they discover films and TV through short form video.

stories.title: YouTube's dynamic thumbnails will favour the winning image per audience
stories.summary: YouTube's upcoming dynamic thumbnails will shift impressions toward whichever image performs best with each audience segment instead of splitting traffic evenly, discovery lead Todd Beaupré said on Creator Insider with MrBeast's head of virality, Net Influencer reports.

stories.title: Pinterest adds more than 20 million users in a quarter
stories.summary: Pinterest's third quarter earnings showed more than 20 million new users since Q2, including 17 million in regions outside its core markets, Social Media Today reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: LinkedIn grows user time, members and creator ads
stories.summary: Microsoft's earnings for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 offered insight into LinkedIn's growth across multiple metrics, including user time, membership and creator ads, Social Media Today reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: Threads tests a Close Friends style sharing option
stories.summary: Threads is testing Threads Friends, which, like Instagram's Close Friends feature, lets users share with a smaller group of up to 50 connections, Social Media Today reports. Group chats, but with a feed.

stories.title: Threads lets users make custom like buttons
stories.summary: Threads users can now personalise reactions to their posts with images or animations, Social Media Today reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary. The heart icon, it turns out, was negotiable.

stories.title: Reddit introduces a For You feed
stories.summary: Reddit has introduced a For You feed, an algorithm defined feed designed to improve in-app discovery with tailored recommendations and updates, Social Media Today reports. The front page of the internet is now also a little bit about you.

stories.title: TikTok adds an in-app restaurant guide called Must Eat
stories.summary: TikTok has added Must Eat, a local dining list designed to showcase community sourced restaurant spots in the US, inside its app, Social Media Today reports. The algorithm already knew what you wanted for dinner.

stories.title: YouTube tests letting channels fix spam violations
stories.summary: YouTube is testing an option that lets channels review content and edit or delete videos that may go against its spam policy, Social Media Today reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: beehiiv adds podcast ad tools for creators
stories.summary: beehiiv has launched podcast advertising tools on all paid plans, including dynamic ad insertion that lets creators place and replace ads in new and past episodes without re-recording, plus programmatic ads and sponsorship management, MarTech Cube reports.

stories.title: Curry Barker brings his next horror film back to YouTube
stories.summary: Curry Barker premiered his next horror film on YouTube two days before Halloween, WeRSM reports. His previous film, Obsession, was one of the year's breakout creator led horror hits and made him a Hollywood commodity, but he is sticking with the platform.

stories.title: YouTube asks Canada to lend money to creators
stories.summary: YouTube Canada wants a lending stream for creators through the Business Development Bank of Canada that factors platform income and IP into credit assessments, The Peak reports. YouTube's own data says creators added $2 billion to Canada's GDP last year.

stories.title: Kenyan creators told to formalise their businesses
stories.summary: EXP Group chief executive Carole Abade told The Media Shift Summit in Nairobi that Kenyan creators should formalise their businesses as brands shift budgets to influencer marketing. 'There's money shifting to them. And they need to be responsible,' she said, The Star reports.

stories.title: Amazon says outside AI agents are not hurting its ads
stories.summary: Amazon's Q3 ad revenue was $19.6 billion, up 11 per cent, and $78 billion over 12 months, Adweek reports, as the company said external AI agents are not hurting its ad business. AWS grew 39 per cent. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Meta's average ad price rose 14 per cent
stories.summary: Meta's ad revenue rose 26 per cent year on year in Q3, driven by a 10 per cent rise in ad impressions and a 14 per cent rise in the average price per ad, Merca2.0 reports. Advertising was about 97.6 per cent of its $64.6 billion revenue.

stories.title: Google's AI search overhaul hits snags as ad growth cools
stories.summary: Google's core search ad revenue growth slowed in Q3 despite a jump in query volume driven by AI features, Marketing Dive reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: YouTube subscriptions rise as viewers move to TV screens
stories.summary: YouTube ad growth slowed in the third quarter of 2026 but still brought in more than $11 billion, according to Alphabet, as subscriptions rose with more viewers watching on connected TV, Social Media Today reports. The full article did not load for us.

stories.title: TikTok opens its ad network to US advertisers
stories.summary: TikTok used New York Advertising Week to expand its TikTok Ad Network, originally launched in 2019 as Pangle, to US based advertisers, letting them reach consumers across almost 400,000 third party publisher apps, MediaPost reports. It also unveiled agentic commerce tools.

stories.title: UK ad spend forecast to hit £51.3 billion this year
stories.summary: UK ad investment is forecast to reach £14.0 billion in Q4, up 8.2 per cent, and £51.3 billion for 2026, per the Advertising Association and WARC, ExchangeWire reports. Retail media surged 31.2 per cent in Q2, helped along by the FIFA World Cup.

stories.title: TikTok bundles brand safety tools for APAC advertisers
stories.summary: TikTok introduced a Brand Safety Center, a Brand Protection Playbook and AI Safety Essentials at its APAC Responsible Media Forum in Singapore, covering content suitability, impersonation and AI made ads, ContentGrip reports. It says campaign level verification remains essential.

stories.title: Disney plans a TikTok Shop holiday event with over 20 brands
stories.summary: Disney will hold a Super Brand Day on TikTok Shop in November featuring products from the Disney Store and brands including Old Navy, Crocs and ColourPop, Marketing Dive reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: Warner Bros chases The Cat in the Hat across Amazon's ad ecosystem
stories.summary: Warner Bros' Open to Fun campaign for The Cat in the Hat includes a mobile minigame, an Alexa integration and placements across Twitch, Prime Video and IMDb, Marketing Dive reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: Teads relaunches its Ad Manager with AI workflows
stories.summary: Teads has launched the next generation of Teads Ad Manager, a unified platform meant to connect campaigns across connected TV and digital, with AI powered workflows and open MCP integrations, MarTech Cube reports. Everything now speaks MCP, including ad buying.

stories.title: RunnTV opens its FAST channels to PubMatic buyers
stories.summary: RunnTV has partnered with PubMatic to make inventory from more than 90 free ad supported streaming channels available to advertisers through PubMatic's platform, afaqs reports. The companies say it reaches over 12 million monthly active devices across Tier 1, 2 and 3 markets.

stories.title: AdsGram adds target cost per action bidding to Telegram ads
stories.summary: AdsGram, a Telegram Ads partner, has launched target cost per action optimisation for campaigns driving traffic to external websites, and says it is the first in the Telegram ecosystem to do so, based on its own review of resellers, MarTech Cube reports.

stories.title: Eighty per cent of marketers feel pressure to prove their value
stories.summary: A Funnel report says 80 per cent of marketers are under pressure to justify their value, and 42 per cent of agency marketers fear AI could eliminate or significantly reduce their role within three years, MarTech Cube reports. 68 per cent have not tried to measure zero-click search.

stories.title: Zocdoc opens its platform to AI agents
stories.summary: Zocdoc has opened its platform to AI agents, which can find providers, verify insurance and book appointments into patients' calendars, Adweek reports. A patient could ask for a dermatologist near 10013 who takes Aetna, ideally this week, and the agent books it.

stories.title: NIQ and Google team up on agentic commerce
stories.summary: NielsenIQ and Google announced a collaboration to bring NIQ's retail and product intelligence into Google's AI commerce ecosystem, complementing a Shopping Graph of more than 60 billion product listings, MarTech Cube reports. NIQ also named Google Cloud a primary cloud provider.

stories.title: More new CMOs now come with AI skills
stories.summary: Over a quarter of CMOs hired this year have AI skills, compared with 9 per cent of those hired four years ago, according to Findem and CMO Huddles data, Marketing Dive reports. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: Retailers weigh tying executive pay to AI goals
stories.summary: Ralph Lauren added AI metrics as a factor that can adjust executives' annual incentive payouts, according to a 131 page SEC disclosure first reported by Reuters, Modern Retail notes via Digiday. A spokesperson said it reinforced opportunities for leveraging AI to enhance our work.

stories.title: The legal risks of algorithmic pricing
stories.summary: Emerging state and federal laws are raising fresh concerns about algorithmic pricing, writes Laura Brett, partner at Simpson Thacher and Bartlett, in Marketing Dive. The full article did not load for us, so this is from its summary.

stories.title: TalentSheets runs influencer campaigns inside Google Sheets
stories.summary: TalentSheets has relaunched its influencer campaign management system inside Google Sheets, letting brands and agencies find, vet, contract and track creators in a spreadsheet, EIN Presswire reports. Plans start at $15 a month. The spreadsheet has, once again, won.

stories.title: Virid lets merchants run stores through AI assistants
stories.summary: Virid has launched the marketAgility MCP Connector, which lets clients manage products, orders, customers and promotions in natural language through AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, MarTech Cube reports. It works with any platform supporting custom MCP connectors.

stories.title: SalesCloser's AI sales agents now answer on WhatsApp
stories.summary: SalesCloser has added WhatsApp as a channel for its AI sales agents, which reply to leads in seconds at any hour with a business's services, pricing and hours, and hand off to a person when needed, MarTech Cube reports.

stories.title: Trademark Global uses Genesys AI agents for customer service
stories.summary: Ecommerce company Trademark Global is using Genesys Cloud's Agentic Virtual Agent across its brands and channels, which Genesys says contributed to a 111 per cent increase in referral code usage, MarTech Cube reports.

stories.title: Ciscom reports Q3 sales up 47.6 per cent
stories.summary: Ciscom Corp reported third quarter sales up 47.6 per cent year on year to $7.7 million, with gross profit nearly tripling and quarterly EBITDA up 240 per cent as it paid down bank debt, The Globe and Mail reports. It is expanding its AI marketing platform.

research.title: BiliPicks: Seven Years of Weekly Platform Curation on Bilibili with Video Metadata, Comments, and Danmaku
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: BiliPicks documents seven years of Bilibili's Weekly Picks, a platform-curated editorial video series. The dataset covers 371 publicly listed issues and 13,758 curated videos from 22 March 2019 to 7 May 2026. It links issue dates. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Curvature-Guided Sparsification for Graphs with Community Structure
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph sparsification in large-scale networks often requires balancing structural accuracy and computational efficiency. Curvature-based methods, particularly Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), have shown strong performance in identifying inter-community bridges, but their computational cost limits scalability. In this work. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Density Decomposition on Hypergraphs
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hypergraphs capture higher-order interactions involving multiple entities. Existing decomposition models, such as $k$-core and nbr-$k$-core, rely on degree or neighborhood constraints and may overlook fine-grained density variations. We propose a $(k,\delta)$-dense subhypergraph model based on capped. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Discovery of connectivity-trainability trade-off of IQP circuits for Hamiltonian optimization
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits are promising candidates for near-term quantum computing due to the conjectured classical hardness of their sampling task and their shallow, highly parallelizable structure. Despite extensive studies of their complexity-theoretic properties, the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Finding Is Not Returning, Returning Is Not Reconstructing: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Agent Social Re-entry
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in persistent social environments, understanding their long-term social interaction capabilities becomes increasingly important. While existing research has advanced long-term memory and conversational context retrieval, less attention has been. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: GenAI as an 'Invisible Hand' in Opinion Dynamics: Evidence from a Group-Level Simulation Study
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent arguments suggest that genAI can act as an invisible hand that gradually shapes social structures, such as collective beliefs and norms. The argument is that if millions of people repeatedly consult genAI tools, their generated. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Industrialized Deception: The Collateral Effects of LLM-Generated Misinformation on Digital Ecosystems
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Generative AI and misinformation research have evolved since our 2024 survey. This paper presents an updated perspective, transitioning from literature review to practical countermeasures. We report on changes in the threat landscape, including improved AI-generated content. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Quantifying displacement: an urban expansion consequence via persistent homology
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Population displacement is a housing-related involuntary residential dislocation. It has become increasingly widespread in many cities, particularly in neighbourhoods undergoing rapid economic and demographic change, and measuring it is essential to assess the social consequences of. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
